title: Tehran Police Dismantle Drug Ring Peddling Crystal Meth and Heroin Along Major Highways
text:
Tehran Police Dismantle Drug Ring Peddling Crystal Meth and Heroin Along Major Highways"

""
"A five-member drug trafficking gang that distributed crystal meth and heroin from makeshift hangouts along the edges of Tehran’s highways—including the Yadgar-e-Imam Expressway and several other major thoroughfares—has been dismantled. The bust was carried out during a targeted technical and intelligence-led operation by the capital's Anti-Narcotics Police, effectively putting an end to the group's illicit street-level sales network across the city's key transit routes.
